name: Lamp
overview: The topic of the lamp in Scripture highlights both its literal and symbolic significance. In Genesis 15:17, a burning lamp miraculously appeared during Abraham's sacrifice, signifying God's presence and covenant. The detailed description in Exodus 25:31-35 of the golden candlestick with its branches, bowls, knops, and flowers reveals the lamp’s central role in the tabernacle, where it was kept burning continually at night and maintained by priests. This lamp not only served practical purposes but also carried deep figurative and symbolic meaning within the worship and relationship between God and His people.
